roadmap.title: Open the Den and learn the systems
roadmap.description: Finish the first mission, then use the Den's Customization terminal, Armory, Recruitment Console and Personnel Table once each. The Armory handles weapon customization and the Black Market.

roadmap.title: Early campaign: story missions, droids and combat feats
roadmap.description: Clear Eavesdropping, Dark Waters, Smugglers' Den and Casualties of War. Repair the Droid Repair Bay, hire droids for the four-Astromech mission and start the droid and custom-operator Bonds. Take the situational combat feats and the controlled Operator loss when a save and a safe fight allow it. Deploy story Operators together for Bonds and accept every Operator offer, including Cly's on Cycles 13-14.

roadmap.title: Mid campaign: Seer, mod slots and Hutt Roulette
roadmap.description: Clear Enemy Intelligence (the first Seer) and Behind Enemy Lines. Build every weapon mod slot, picking the weapon mod option at Underworld Intel. Fill the roster to 20 and max the Zone that holds the Hutt Roulette prize, saving first.

roadmap.title: Late campaign: finish stories, Bonds and counters
roadmap.description: Finish Stillwatch, Deep Cover, Unfinished Business and The Infinite Coil. Complete all six Operator stories and the Bond pairs, and bring the optional-mission, kill and Zone Reward totals to their targets. Finishing on Hard or higher also earns the three lower difficulty awards.

roadmap.title: Expert with Beskar Mode, then the completion award
roadmap.description: Beat the game on Expert with Beskar Mode on, which covers Expert too. Zero Company Legend unlocks when every other achievement is done.

achievements.description: Beat the game on Story or higher
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on Story difficulty, or on a harder one.

steps.text: Play the campaign to the end on Story difficulty or higher.

achievements.displayName: In a galaxy far, far away....
achievements.description: Complete your first mission.
achievements.summary: Complete your first mission.

steps.text: Finish the first mission, @loc{The Serolonis Job}, on Cycle 1.

achievements.description: Beat the game on Normal or higher
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on Normal difficulty, or on a harder one.

steps.text: Play the campaign to the end on Normal difficulty or higher.

achievements.description: Customized a member of Zero Company
achievements.summary: Customize a member of Zero Company.

steps.text: In the @loc{Den}, go to the Customization terminal beside @npc{Neesh} and the Armory. Change the appearance of any character; Hawks counts.

achievements.description: Beat the game on Hard or higher
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on Hard difficulty, or on a harder one.

steps.text: Play the campaign to the end on Hard difficulty or higher.

achievements.description: Made a purchase at The Black Market
achievements.summary: Buy an item at the Black Market.

steps.text: After the tutorial missions, open the Armory in the @loc{Den}, choose the Black Market tab, and buy any item.

achievements.description: Beat the game on Expert
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on Expert difficulty.

steps.text: Start a campaign on Expert difficulty and play it to the end.
Winning on Expert with Beskar Mode also counts, so you can earn this and Legend in one run.

achievements.description: Beat the game on Expert and Beskar Mode
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on Expert difficulty with Beskar Mode turned on.

guide.context: Beskar Mode is the single-save, no-reload mode.

steps.text: Start a new campaign on Expert difficulty and switch on Beskar Mode.
Play the campaign to the end.
Beskar Mode keeps one autosave. A Game Over on any mission, side missions included, deletes the save for good. Learn the missions on an easier campaign first.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Eavesdropping".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Eavesdropping".

steps.text: Finish "Eavesdropping" by Cycle 4. You meet Bennic and Jae just before it, and Jae joins.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Dark Waters".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Dark Waters".

steps.text: Finish the "Loose Lips" operation to open "Dark Waters", then finish that mission by Cycle 8.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Smugglers' Den".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Smugglers' Den".

steps.text: Finish the "Our Jedi Friend" operation to open "Smugglers' Den", then finish that mission by Cycle 12. Tel-Rea joins at its end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Casualties of War".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Casualties of War".

steps.text: Finish the "Strange Bedfellows" operation to open "Casualties of War", then finish that mission by Cycle 18. Luco joins at its end.
Do it earlier than Cycle 18 if you want more time to build Bonds with Luco.

achievements.displayName: A Way to Pass the Time
achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Enemy Intelligence".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Enemy Intelligence".

steps.text: Finish the operation "The Ossic Hand" to open "Enemy Intelligence", then finish that mission by Cycle 20.
When Typhon appears, run for extraction. Strafing Vulture Droids deal lethal damage.

achievements.description: Landed a 10% or lower chance to hit shot!
achievements.summary: Hit an enemy with a shot that only had a 10% chance or less.

steps.text: Give an Operator a Blaster Pistol.
Move only far enough to bring the hit chance down to about 10%. Fire again and again, since each shot costs 1 AP. Astromechs can feed bonus AP to the shooter.
Take these shots only when a miss costs you nothing.

achievements.description: Missed a 90% or greater chance to hit shot!
achievements.summary: Miss a shot that had a 90% or higher chance to hit.

steps.text: Keep playing normally. A miss at 90% or higher will usually come up on its own.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Behind Enemy Lines".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Behind Enemy Lines".

steps.text: Finish the "Quid Pro Quo" operation to open "Behind Enemy Lines", then finish that mission by Cycle 25. It has 4 stages and ends with a boss fight against Visser at the top of the Citadel.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Stillwatch".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Stillwatch".

steps.text: Finish the "Enemy of My Enemy" operation to open "Stillwatch". The mission happens on Cycle 28.
Leave Tel-Rea and Trick out of your squad. They join automatically, giving you 5 Operators. If you bring both, you get only 3.

achievements.description: Force Push or Force Pull one enemy so it crashes into a second enemy.
achievements.summary: Force Push or Force Pull one enemy so it crashes into a second enemy.

guide.context: Tel-Rea joins at the end of "Smugglers' Den". The enemy may hit objects on the way, but it must end by hitting another living enemy.

steps.text: Use Tel-Rea's Push or Pull on an enemy standing close to another enemy, so the first one slams into the second.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Deep Cover".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Deep Cover".

steps.text: Finish the "Operation Trick" operation to open "Deep Cover" on Umbara, then finish that mission by Cycle 32.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Unfinished Business".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Unfinished Business".

steps.text: Finish the "Chut Chut, Pateesa" operation to open "Unfinished Business" on Kaller, then finish that mission by Cycle 33.

achievements.description: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Trick to the Very High level.
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Trick to the Very High level.

steps.text: Deploy Hawks and Trick together as often as you can. Adding Luco builds Sharp Shooters and Heroes on Both Sides at the same time.
Each mission, use Call for Backup twice and make about five support actions such as healing or giving bonus AP. Avoid grenade friendly fire. At each Bond level-up, take the +40 Bond XP option.

achievements.description: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Luco to Very High.
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Luco to Very High.

guide.context: Luco gains no Bond XP with Hawks until he joins after "Casualties of War", so finish that mission early.

steps.text: Finish "Casualties of War" to recruit Luco, by Cycle 18 at the latest.
Deploy Hawks and Luco together on every mission and operation that fits. A squad of Hawks, Trick and Luco also builds Old Friends and Heroes on Both Sides.
Each mission, use Call for Backup twice and make about five support actions such as healing or giving bonus AP. Avoid grenade friendly fire. At each Bond level-up, take the +40 Bond XP option.

achievements.description: Lost a member of Zero Company
achievements.summary: Have a member of Zero Company die permanently.

guide.context: An Operator dies after 3 Injuries. Losing Aurelio in the opening mission, planting a Sabotage bomb, abandoning the crew, and marking someone Missing In Action do not count.

steps.text: Make a hard save before a fight.
Let an Operator you can spare take 3 Injuries until they die. A spare recruit next to an Astromech throwing grenades works well.
Outside Beskar Mode, reload your save afterwards to get the Operator back.
Do not use an Operator you still need for a Bond or story achievement.

achievements.description: Applied a Focus Point
achievements.summary: Spend a Focus Point.

steps.text: After the tutorial missions, spend a @mechanic{Focus Point} on any Operator at the Personnel Table in the @loc{Den}.

achievements.description: Complete the final story mission "The Infinite Coil".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "The Infinite Coil".

steps.text: Finish "The Infinite Coil". It happens by Cycle 39 at the latest. You can reach it around Cycle 29 by doing nothing but story operations and missions.

achievements.description: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Kabb to Very High.
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Kabb to Very High.

steps.text: Deploy Hawks and Kabb together from the moment Kabb joins. A squad of Hawks, Kabb and Jae also builds Class and Distinction and The Baroness and the Boxer.
Each mission, use Call for Backup twice and make about five support actions such as healing or giving bonus AP. Avoid grenade friendly fire. At each Bond level-up, take the +40 Bond XP option.

achievements.description: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Jae to Very High.
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Jae to Very High.

steps.text: Deploy Hawks and Jae together from the moment she joins, just before "Eavesdropping". A squad of Hawks, Kabb and Jae also builds Mate and Marrow and The Baroness and the Boxer.
Each mission, use Call for Backup twice and make about five support actions such as healing or giving bonus AP. Avoid grenade friendly fire. At each Bond level-up, take the +40 Bond XP option.

achievements.description: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Cly to Very High.
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Cly to Very High.

steps.text: Accept Cly's offer to join on Cycle 13-14.
Deploy Hawks and Cly together from the moment she joins.
Each mission, use Call for Backup twice and make about five support actions such as healing or giving bonus AP. Avoid grenade friendly fire. At each Bond level-up, take the +40 Bond XP option.
Refusing Cly's offer twice removes her for the rest of the campaign.

achievements.description: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Tel-Rea to Very High.
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between Hawks and Tel-Rea to Very High.

steps.text: Deploy Hawks and Tel-Rea together from the moment she joins at the end of "Smugglers' Den".
Each mission, use Call for Backup twice and make about five support actions such as healing or giving bonus AP. Avoid grenade friendly fire. At each Bond level-up, take the +40 Bond XP option.

achievements.description: Raise the Bond between Trick and Luco to Very High.
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between Trick and Luco to Very High.

guide.context: This is one of the hardest Bond pairs. Luco joins late, and the two start with no Affinity.

steps.text: Deploy Trick and Luco together from the moment Luco joins after "Casualties of War". A squad of Hawks, Trick and Luco also builds Old Friends and Sharp Shooters.
Each mission, use Call for Backup twice and make about five support actions such as healing or giving bonus AP. Avoid grenade friendly fire. At each Bond level-up, take the +40 Bond XP option.

achievements.description: Raise the Bond between Kabb and Jae to Very High.
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between Kabb and Jae to Very High.

steps.text: Deploy Kabb and Jae together on every mission and operation that fits. A squad of Hawks, Kabb and Jae also builds Mate and Marrow and Class and Distinction.
Each mission, use Call for Backup twice and make about five support actions such as healing or giving bonus AP. Avoid grenade friendly fire. At each Bond level-up, take the +40 Bond XP option.

achievements.description: Reached Very High Bond between Two Custom Operators
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between any two Custom Operators to Very High.

guide.context: Custom Operators are the ones you hire yourself, not named story characters.

steps.text: Hire two Custom Operators at the Recruitment Console, as early as you can.
Deploy the two together on missions and on operations that take several Operators.
Each mission, use Call for Backup twice and make about five support actions such as healing or giving bonus AP. Avoid grenade friendly fire. At each Bond level-up, take the +40 Bond XP option.

achievements.description: Reached Very High Bond between Two Astromechs
achievements.summary: Raise the Bond between any two Astromechs to Very High.

steps.text: Finish the Droid Repair Bay in the @loc{Den}. Astromech BR-1 joins when it is done.
Hire one more Astromech at the Recruitment Console.
Deploy the two together on missions, and send both on operations that take several Operators.
Astromechs cannot call for Backup, so take the +40 Bond XP option at each Bond level-up to catch up.

achievements.description: Complete Trick's story.
achievements.summary: Complete Trick's story.

guide.context: Missing one of this Operator's offered operations or missions, or losing the Operator to 3 Injuries or Missing In Action, makes this impossible in that campaign.

steps.text: Accept and finish every operation and mission that Trick offers.
Finish the last two story missions, which involve Trick and Luco. This also completes Luco's story.

achievements.description: Complete Luco's story.
achievements.summary: Complete Luco's story.

guide.context: Missing one of this Operator's offered operations or missions, or losing the Operator to 3 Injuries or Missing In Action, makes this impossible in that campaign.

steps.text: Luco joins at the end of "Casualties of War". Accept and finish every operation and mission he offers.
Finish the last two story missions, which involve Luco and Trick. This also completes Trick's story.
Tel-Rea's mission "Origin of Infection" overlaps Luco's mission "Lord of Betrayal" around Cycles 22-23. Skip one Coil Crisis mission before Cycle 23 to do both.

achievements.description: Complete Kabb's story.
achievements.summary: Complete Kabb's story.

guide.context: Missing one of this Operator's offered operations or missions, or losing the Operator to 3 Injuries or Missing In Action, makes this impossible in that campaign.

steps.text: Accept and finish every operation and mission that Kabb offers.

achievements.description: Complete Jae's story.
achievements.summary: Complete Jae's story.

guide.context: Missing one of this Operator's offered operations or missions, or losing the Operator to 3 Injuries or Missing In Action, makes this impossible in that campaign.

steps.text: Accept and finish every operation and mission that Jae offers.

achievements.description: Complete Cly's story.
achievements.summary: Complete Cly's story.

guide.context: Missing one of this Operator's offered operations or missions, or losing the Operator to 3 Injuries or Missing In Action, makes this impossible in that campaign.

steps.text: Accept Cly's offer to join on Cycle 13-14. Refusing twice removes her for the rest of the campaign.
Accept and finish every operation and mission that Cly offers.

achievements.description: Complete Tel-Rea's story.
achievements.summary: Complete Tel-Rea's story.

guide.context: Missing one of this Operator's offered operations or missions, or losing the Operator to 3 Injuries or Missing In Action, makes this impossible in that campaign.

steps.text: Accept and finish every operation and mission that Tel-Rea offers.
After her last story mission, "Sisters", finish the follow-up operations that investigate Rawn. The achievement unlocks after those.
Tel-Rea's mission "Origin of Infection" overlaps Luco's mission "Lord of Betrayal" around Cycles 22-23. Skip one Coil Crisis mission before Cycle 23 to do both.

achievements.description: Completed 50 Optional Missions
achievements.summary: Complete 50 Optional Missions.

guide.context: Only truly optional missions count. Critical story missions and missions for named Operators such as Kabb, Jae and Trick do not. Progress carries between campaigns.

steps.text: Take optional missions whenever the Holotable offers them, and finish each one.

Outside Beskar Mode: save just before the last action of an optional mission, such as planting the final bomb or killing the last enemy. Win the mission, then reload that save and win again. Repeat until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Knocked an enemy out of the combat space
achievements.summary: Force an enemy out of the fight area, such as over a ledge or into a pit.

steps.text: On a map with bottomless pits or open edges, push an enemy over with a melee Shove, a Concussion Grenade, a jetpack, or a Jedi's Push or Pull.

achievements.description: Defeated 10 enemies from a higher elevation
achievements.summary: Defeat 10 enemies from higher ground than theirs.

steps.text: Take high positions and kill from there. Kills across different missions add up.
Grenades thrown from high ground count. Missions with B1 Battle Droids, which die in one hit, are the easiest.

achievements.description: Completed a mission using 4 Astromechs
achievements.summary: Complete a mission with 4 Astromechs on your squad.

guide.context: The Droid Repair Bay holds exactly 4 droids. With 4 Astromechs on the squad, nobody can use Call for Backup.

steps.text: Finish the Droid Repair Bay in the @loc{Den}. Astromech BR-1 joins when it is done.
Hire 3 more Astromechs at the Recruitment Console.
Send all 4 on a short optional Sabotage mission, such as @loc{Cold Metal}. Plant the bomb and leave.

achievements.description: Defeat a total of 1,138 enemies during tactical missions.
achievements.summary: Defeat a total of 1,138 enemies during tactical missions.

guide.context: Kills add up across all campaigns.

steps.text: Fight in every tactical mission. Optional missions full of B1 Battle Droids, which die in one hit, add kills fastest.

achievements.description: Defeat a Seer enemy with a single hit.
achievements.summary: Defeat a Seer enemy with a single hit.

guide.context: A Seer is a Coil enemy. Damaging it first ruins the attempt, so one attack must do the kill. The mission "Enemy Intelligence" has many bottomless pits.

steps.text: In the mission "Enemy Intelligence", find the Seer near the end of the bridge, with 3 Coil Scourge melee units. Hover over enemies to check the name.
Without damaging the Seer first, push it off a ledge with a melee Shove, a Concussion Grenade, a jetpack, or Tel-Rea's Push or Pull.
Save on the turn the Seer appears so you can retry.

achievements.description: Recruited an Operator
achievements.summary: Recruit an Operator.

steps.text: After the tutorial missions, open the Recruitment Console beside the Personnel Console in the @loc{Den} and hire any Operator. The first hire costs 500 Credits.

achievements.description: Recruited 20 Operators in a single campaign
achievements.summary: Have 20 Operators on your roster in a single campaign.

steps.text: Build all 4 Crew Quarters upgrades in the @loc{Den}. Without them the roster limit stays below 20.
Save Credits. Each hire costs 500 Credits plus 50 for every Custom Operator or Astromech already on your roster. Named story Operators do not add to the price.
Hire at the Recruitment Console until your roster holds 20 Operators. The achievement unlocks when the 20th joins.

achievements.displayName: To the Victor Go the Spoils
achievements.description: Unlocked a Zone Reward
achievements.summary: Earn a Zone Reward by getting any Zone to Tier 1 Influence.

guide.context: Contacts come from critical missions and operations.

steps.text: At the Holotable, switch to the Influence tab and pick any Zone.
Spend @mechanic{Contacts} there, each worth 7 or more Influence, or finish operations located in that Zone.
Reach 20 Influence in that Zone to unlock its Tier 1 reward.

achievements.description: Unlocked all the Zone Rewards
achievements.summary: Unlock every Zone Reward, up to Tier 3 in all 12 Zones.

guide.context: Zones maxed in earlier campaigns still count, so progress carries between campaigns.

steps.text: At the Holotable, switch to the Influence tab and note which Zones have not reached Tier 3.
Hold your Contacts until you have built the Persuasion I or II Den upgrade. Each Contact then gives +9 or +12 Influence.
Take the Zone Grek Tier 2 reward early. It raises the Influence you gain from operations and missions.
Send operations to the Zones with the least Influence.
Outside Beskar Mode: save before spending Contacts to max one Zone, then reload and spend them on a different Zone. Repeat until every Zone has reached Tier 3 once.

achievements.description: Win the Hutt Roulette Prize on three separate occasions.
achievements.summary: Win the Hutt Roulette Prize on three separate occasions.

guide.context: This prize is most likely the Tier 3 reward of Zone Jenth, and it may be won only once per campaign. Wins may add up across campaigns.

steps.text: At the Holotable, switch to the Influence tab and look for Zone Jenth.
Bring Zone Jenth close to Tier 3, then save the game.
Reach Tier 3 there with a Contact or an operation. The Hutt Roulette Prize should trigger.
Outside Beskar Mode: reload that save and reach Tier 3 again, then do it a third time.

achievements.description: Equipped 4 Weapon Mods to a Weapon
achievements.summary: Equip 4 Weapon Mods on one weapon.

guide.context: A weapon starts with 1 mod slot, and you need 3 more.

steps.text: Get the @loc{Den} to Level 4. In its Crew upgrades, build the node named Additional Weapon Mod Slot.
Bring Zone Forn to Tier 3 in the Influence tab for a second extra slot.

When the Underworld Intel operation offers a choice, pick Modification Attachment, not the Utility Slot. The choice is permanent. The operation appears by Cycle 26 at the latest, after the mission "Behind Enemy Lines".
Equip one mod of each type (Barrel, Power Cells, Scope and Stabilizer) on one blaster. Astromechs and Trick's DC-17M cannot take mods.

achievements.description: Customized a Weapon
achievements.summary: Customize a weapon.

steps.text: After the tutorial missions, open the Armory in the @loc{Den}, choose Weapon Customization, and change anything on a weapon.

achievements.description: Completed all other achievements
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement.

steps.text: Earn the other 52 achievements. This one unlocks right after the last of them.
